description: This file defines the Review model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to add reviews and retrieve review data for products.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Model class providing review-related database operations within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Creates a new product review record in the database with author, customer ID, product ID, review text, rating, and timestamps.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specified product, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total number of reviews for a specified product.
